entries.title: Ezekiel 35:1
segments:
CHAP. XXXV. 
 
  A prophecy against Edom for their hatred to Israel, ver. 1-13.   Their ruin shall be perpetual, ver. 14, 15.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:2
segments: V. 2. Mount Seir-The Edomites, who inhabited it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:5
segments: V. 5. Their iniquity-When their iniquity was punished on them, which brought them to final ruin.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:6
segments: V. 6. And blood-Thy guilt, and my just revenge of innocent blood. Hast not hated-Thou hast loved, rather than hated, blood-shed; therefore vengeance for it follows thee.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:7
segments: V. 7. That passeth out-All travellers that go to or from Edom.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:10
segments: V. 10. Though-Though God was with Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 35:14
segments: V. 14. The whole earth-The inhabitants of all the countries round about thee.  Rejoiceth-Is in peace and plenty.
